remainingApprovedCoordinateBacklog.conflict: Official Maridalsveien 3 address point exactly overlaps xray_ungdomskulturhus.
institutionPhysicalEvidence: ROM identifies its location as Maridalsveien 3, building O.
ROM identifies the entrance area at the Maridalsveien/Brenneriveien meeting point and a route through the property entrance.

remainingApprovedCoordinateBacklog.machineFallbackResult: No named ROM POI and no uniquely attributable entrance/building O object was resolved. A first-pass false positive caused by matching “rom” inside “klasserom” was explicitly rejected.
remainingApprovedCoordinateBacklog.decision: Remain coordinate-blocked; no synthetic offset and no proximity-only entrance selection.

remainingApprovedCoordinateBacklog.conflict: Official Rådhusgata 20 address point exactly overlaps fotografiens_hus.
institutionPhysicalEvidence: SOFT identifies its entrance as the corner entrance at Rådhusgata 20.
SOFT identifies the large gallery window as facing northeast toward Rådhusgata.
remainingApprovedCoordinateBacklog.machineFallbackResult: OSM resolved the containing building as osm:way/112191362, but no entrance node on that building uniquely identifies SOFT. The only nearby mapped main entrance returned by the pass is not a member of the containing building.
remainingApprovedCoordinateBacklog.decision: Remain coordinate-blocked; do not convert a building-polygon corner or nearby entrance into a canonical coordinate by inference.

finalRule: The VisitOSLO Galleries scope is fully decided. Production is complete for every approved candidate that currently has a defensible distinct coordinate anchor. The two remaining approved items are deliberately withheld until authoritative distinct anchors exist.
